text:
alex chen: Heads-up, planning a short preflight for a snapshot-based surge on kernel-quant v5.2 tonight (quiet window). Want to exercise deploybot snapshot mode and validate thermal/kv-cache behavior before the regional cutover.

Tess williams: timeline? I can own smoke if it's in the 22:00-23:30 UTC slot.

alex chen: aiming for 22:15 start, 45m window. Keep canary to 1% traffic, snapshot will create a warm image we can scale to 3x for brief load sim.

maya rao: are we pinning runtime ABI for the snapshot? last time a drift caused small speed regressions.

alex chen: yes, explicit pin. deploybot command will include --pin-runtime=2026-03-12-abi1 and a sticky ttl of 6h for safety.

jamie ng: what are rollback gates? latency p95 > 2x baseline or error-rate spike > 0.5% for 10m?

tess williams: +1 on those. also watch KV cache hit rate; last surge we saw a warmed-up spike then a drop. add kv_hit_rate < 85% for 5m as a gate.

alex chen: good call. summarize gates: p95 latency > 2x OR error-rate > 0.5% for 10m OR kv_hit_rate < 85% for 5m. Any other abort signals?

maya rao: GPU thermal alarms (node-level) and OOMs. If deploybot reports >1 host OOM in canary slice, immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: [info] deploy snapshot created: snapshot-id=snap-1767777-surgetest, bundle=kernel-quant:v5.2, pin=2026-03-12-abi1, ttl=6h, canary=1%

jamie ng: release notes blurb needed — small note on snapshot surge test and pinned ABI, plus how to revert (deploybot rollback snap-1767777). I'll draft.

tess williams: smoke checklist: 1) quick generate/compare p50/p95 on staging probe 2) run kv-cache warmstart probe 3) run 100 concurrent short chat sessions to catch tokenization regressions 4) check tracing for unexpected kernels used

alex chen: adding metrics dashboard: eng/runtime/snap-surgetest with p50/p95, errors, kv_hit_rate, host_oom_count, kernel_variant_breakdown. Will provision alert channels to #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime.

maya rao: who is oncall to hit rollback if we see OOMs? @jamie and @tess volunteer?

jamie ng: I can be primary for the window, tess backup.

alex chen: fine — jamie primary, tess backup. I'll run the deploybot steps and call out start in thread. Keep responses short in the window.

deploy-bot: [action] canary-routing applied -> 1% traffic to snap-1767777-surgetest. Monitoring hooks active.

alex chen: starting synthetic load now (small ramp). Observing p95 ~ baseline + 3%. Not alarm yet.

tess williams: kv_hit_rate is 91% initially, good. Traces show expected kernel quant path.

maya rao: thermal steady, no host OOMs.

jamie ng: errors 0.02%, latency p95 within 1.1x for the last 5m. Continue ramp to brief surge at 3x capacity in 10m.

alex chen: ramping to surge target. reminder: if any gate tripped, manual rollback with `deploybot rollback snapshot snap-1767777-surgetest` or I can trigger immediate unpin.

deploy-bot: [alert] host_oom_count=1 detected in canary slice (node id: gpu-554).

tess williams: saw that too, jamie you want to rollback?

jamie ng: rolling back now.

deploy-bot: [action] rollback initiated -> snap-1767777-surgetest rolled back, traffic reverted. pin removed.

alex chen: confirmed rollback. opening issue to track root cause (likely local memory allotment under surge). Will follow up with a thermal/memory tune before next attempt.

maya rao: adding postmortem stub: steps to repro, config used, OOM logs attached.

jamie ng: release notes: aborted surge test due to host OOM; pinned ABI unchanged. I'll update the changelog and notify product.

tess williams: thanks all. If no objections we close this thread after postmortem link. :thumbsup:

alex chen: no objections. i'll post the issue and link here shortly. thanks for quick responses everyone.
